datasets.name: HireFlow Canonical Scoring Specification
datasets.purpose: Single source of truth defining all 5 pillars, weights, dynamic context profiles, and sensitivity band parameters.
datasets.biasesOrLimitations: Calibrated specifically for software engineering and technology cohorts; non-technical roles use general baseline defaults.

datasets.name: Technology Skills Taxonomy & Directed Implication Graph
datasets.purpose: Keyword boundaries, tech synonyms, and transitive evidence credit (e.g. Next.js implies React, Kotlin implies Java).
datasets.biasesOrLimitations: Focuses primarily on modern web, cloud, data, and systems engineering stacks; specialized legacy mainframe skills are Source pending.

datasets.name: Multi-Cohort Synthetic Evaluation Gold Corpus
datasets.purpose: Test-retest stability, monotonicity guarantees, and score drift detection across 24 distinct student and lateral cohorts.
datasets.biasesOrLimitations: Synthetic resumes represent prototypical resumes across tiers and colleges; individual human resumes may contain unexpected typography.

datasets.name: Indian Tech Market Hiring Archetypes & TalentLens Catalog
datasets.purpose: Calibrates 6 market archetypes (Big Tech, Quant, Unicorns, GCCs, IT Services, Early Startups) with verified eligibility rules and audited employer profiles.
datasets.source: TalentLens engine calibration dataset & Companies-100 verified ledger (docs/companies-100/ledger/)
datasets.biasesOrLimitations: Campus placement criteria vary by tier and season; official TCS eligibility requires 60% aggregate across 10th, 12th, and degree. Legacy profiles are legacy_unaudited; new 94 employer profiles carry sourced audit provenance with zero runtime egress.

datasets.name: AICTE & Regional Campus Placement Standards
datasets.purpose: Flags Indian resume practices (photos, declarations, permanent address) without applying ATS score deductions.
datasets.source: AICTE Model Curriculum & Indian Engineering College Placement Cell Guidelines
datasets.biasesOrLimitations: Editorial guidance only; regional campus placement offices frequently mandate physical declarations that international ATS systems omit.

datasets.name: External Academic Hiring Correlation Models
datasets.purpose: Empirical correlation coefficients linking ATS keyword density directly to real-world interview callbacks.
datasets.biasesOrLimitations: No external universal ATS callback dataset is publicly published by hiring platforms. HireFlow labels all scores as simulation estimates.
